sources.title: Presidency of the Republic of Algeria

capital.evidence_quote: Algiers is the constitutional capital and political seaport seat of the Algerian state

currency.evidence_quote: The Algerian Dinar (DZD, DA) is the sovereign currency governed by Banque d'Algérie

timezone.evidence_quote: Algeria operates on Central European Time (UTC+1) year-round without seasonal clock change

voltage.evidence_quote: National single-phase household power distribution across Algeria is nominal 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Interconnected power network maintains standard 50 Hz synchronised alternating current

plug_types.evidence_quote: Standard Europlug Type C and round grounded Type F sockets are universal in Algeria

police.evidence_quote: Dial 17 nationwide (or 1548 via mobile networks) for Police Nationale emergency intervention

ambulance.evidence_quote: Dial 14 for Protection Civile paramedics, medical rescue, and emergency ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 14 to summon the civil protection fire brigades and disaster rescue teams

general.evidence_quote: Emergency number 112 connects callers to integrated police and emergency response routing

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Tembihli Seyahat (Kıyı ve Tarihi Şehirler Sakin; Güney Sahra ve Sınır Hatları Kısıtlı)
advisory_headline.en: Exercise Increased Caution (Coastal Cities Safe; Remote Southern Desert & Borders Restricted)
advisory_headline.de: Erhöhte Vorsicht (Küstenzone und historische Städte sicher; südliche Sahararegionen meiden)
advisory_headline.ru: Проявляйте повышенную осторожность (Побережье безопасно; южные пустынные зоны ограничены)
advisory_headline.es: Tenga mayor precaución (Zona costera y ciudades seguras; desierto sur y fronteras restringidos)

regional_warnings.area: Southern desert borders (Mali, Niger, Libya, Mauritania)
regional_warnings.reason: Terrorism and kidnapping risks; foreign tourists strictly require certified local guide permits

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Algeria registers median mobile cellular download speeds around 16.5 Mbps on 4G LTE networks

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Algerian fixed broadband median download benchmark registers around 14.8 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Prepaid SIM cards available upon passport registration with Mobilis, Djezzy, or Ooredoo; international travel eSIMs widely operational
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card registration mandates valid passport verification under ARPCE telecom regulations

religion.value: Islam (Sunni ~99%), small Christian and Jewish communities

sources.title: Ministry of Religious Affairs of Algeria

religion.evidence_quote: Sunni Islam of the Maliki school is the state religion observed by over 98% of citizens

festivals.value: Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Mawlid, Yennayer (Amazigh New Year, Jan 12), Revolution Day (Nov 1)
festivals.evidence_quote: Yennayer celebrated as official public holiday alongside Islamic festivals and Revolution Day

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Modest clothing recommended when visiting historical medinas and rural areas; photographing military or security installations is strictly prohibited; Saharan expeditions require certified local desert guides
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Desert travel regulations require authorized licensed local guiding and security coordination

tipping.value: Discretionary; rounding up the bill or leaving 5-10% in sit-down restaurants and cafes is standard customary practice
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is appreciated for good table service though service charges may be included in hotels
